Frequently asked questions

How many Software Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 200 open Software Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 26, 2026.

How much do Software Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $108,500–$384,800 a year, based on 15 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Software Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include GovCIO (32 listings), Maximus Inc. (19 listings), Pinterest (12 listings), ClickHouse (9 listings), and Hercules (8 listings).

Are there entry-level Software Engineer jobs in the United States?

19 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.

Is every listing fully remote from any state?

Check each listing; some remote jobs are limited to certain states or include location and worksite requirements. A remote label does not mean work from anywhere.
